# AdSure

> AdSure (www.adsure.in) reviews Meta (Facebook and Instagram) and Google ads before you spend money on them. Ad experts and AI check the creative, ad text, landing page and targeting, give a score out of 10 and a simple fix for every problem. Made for Indian businesses, with Indian ad rules (ASCI, health claims, RBI loan ads, real-money gaming) built in. AdSure never logs in to your ad account.

Not to be confused with: Adsure Gel (an adapalene acne medicine sold in India) or Adsure Services PLC (a UK risk and assurance company). AdSure at adsure.in is unrelated to both.

Key facts:

- What it is: an ad review service for small and growing businesses in India that run Meta and Google ads. It is not an agency and does not run or change your ads; you make the changes yourself.
- Who reviews: AdSure's ad team (15+ years of running ads) plus AI built on Meta and Google rules and India data.
- What you get: expert + AI review of creative, ad text, landing page and targeting; AI score out of 10 with exact fixes; 5 full expert reviews a month; ask an expert anytime by text or voice (English, Hindi or Hinglish); AI competitor research with competitors' live Meta and Google ads; best time to run ads (5 years of Google searches in India matched to festivals); website and landing page check on a phone.
- Price: ₹2,999 a month or ₹19,999 a year (yearly saves 44% and includes a free 60-minute expert call every quarter), plus 18% GST. Monthly plan gets a free 60-minute expert call after every 6 payments in a row. One-on-one expert calls: ₹1,499 for 30 minutes, ₹2,599 for 60 minutes. No lock-in; cancel anytime. Payments by Razorpay (UPI, card, net banking) with a GST invoice.
- Status: in beta with early access (500 seats). Joining early access is free; you pay only when your seat opens.
- Account safety: no ad account login or password needed, no automatic changes to your ads.
- Free tool: an ad attention heatmap at /heatmap, no sign-up; it runs in the browser and the ad never leaves your device.
- Company: Indian company founded by Vyom Gupta. Contact hi@adsure.in, WhatsApp +91 76074 92323, Instagram @adsure.in.

## Free tools and guides

- [Free ad attention heatmap](https://www.adsure.in/heatmap): see where eyes land first on an ad image or video; free, no sign-up
- [12-point check before you spend](https://www.adsure.in/guides/ad-checklist): creative, ad text, landing page, tracking, budget, audience, timing and ad rules for Meta and Google ads in India
- [Indian ad rules in plain words](https://www.adsure.in/guides/indian-ad-rules): ASCI truthful-claims code, influencer labels, health and cure claims, loan ads under RBI rules, real-money gaming and fake urgency
- [Festival ad calendar 2027 for India](https://www.adsure.in/guides/festival-ad-calendar-2027): festival and sale dates for 2027 with a suggested date to start ads
